title: Good Once Set Up
text: Good Once Set Up. This was a lot of work to set up.  I expected a pre-made plastic thing, instead I got a pile of wood and screws with okay instructions.  Took about 15 minutes, which is way more time than I want to spend, so it took me months to get around to it.  Can you tell I'm a procrastinator yet?  Anyway, I'd look for something that comes premade if I were getting another one.

product_metadata.title: J JACKCUBE DESIGN Laundry Soap Dispenser Station Stand, Laundry Detergent Cup Holder for Easy Pouring and Soap Catcher Storage and Organization- MK901A
features: [LAUNDRY DETERGENT HOLDER]- No more mess while washing clothes. Our rustic laundry detergent stand is designed with a flat surface for extra stability and a drip catcher cup below to easily catch the soap at an optimal height. No more need to lift heavy detergent bottles

[QUALITY DESIGN] - Different to others, our laundry soap station is made of sturdy paulownia wood and comes with a small drawer to store small items such as fabric softener sheets, and other laundry necessities while saving counter space. Drip catching section comes with protective cover for easy cleaning

[KEEP SPACE CLEAN]- Keep your laundry room clean and organized by keeping your laundry detergents of any size on our stand. Easy to carry, and store in drawers or on top of washing machines, while preventing soap from dripping on shelves or floor
[EXTRA SUPPORT]- No need to worry about detergent falling down as it comes with velcro straps to keep it securely in place, even during washing cycle. Designed to support up to 13lb weight
[PERFECT SIZE] Perfect size of 13.3" x 6.7" x 3.7" will fit any small spaces. Makes a great addition for limited storage area as it helps maintain its space neat and ready to use
